summary.en: Good opening habits, then play a bot.
summary.zh: 开局的好习惯，然后和机器人下一盘。

text.en: Good opening habits: bring out your horses and chariots, control the centre, and keep your general safe.
text.zh: 开局的好习惯：出马出车，控制中路，保护老帅。

text.en: A classic first move is the Central Cannon (中炮): move a cannon to the middle file.
text.zh: 经典的第一步是“中炮”：把一个炮移到中路。

hint.en: Slide a cannon sideways to file 5.

wrong.en: Good try — but put a cannon on the middle file.
wrong.zh: 不错的尝试——不过请把炮放到中路。

success.en: 炮二平五 — the most popular opening of all.
success.zh: 炮二平五——最流行的开局。

text.en: Black answered with a horse. Now bring out one of your horses.
text.zh: 黑方跳马应对。现在你也跳出一个马。

hint.en: A horse jumps up toward the centre.

success.en: Good development! Next, get your chariots moving.
success.zh: 出子很好！接下来让车动起来。

text.en: Which is a good first move?

explanation.en: The central cannon aims straight at Black's general and helps your other pieces come out.
explanation.zh: 中炮直指黑将，也有利于其他棋子出动。

text.en: You know all the pieces and rules now. Go and play your first game against a bot — Little Soldier is waiting!
text.zh: 你已经学会了所有棋子和规则。去和机器人下第一盘棋吧——小兵在等你！
